name: pnp-spfx-copilot-component-my-projects-agent
title: My Planner Projects Agent
shortDescription: Review accessible Planner projects and prepare new plans with explicit user confirmation in Microsoft 365 Copilot.
longDescription: My Planner Projects Agent helps users review accessible Planner projects, surface overdue or upcoming work, and open a selected project in Planner.

It can prepare a new Planner plan from supported templates and creates the plan, buckets, and tasks only after the user confirms. The component uses delegated Microsoft Graph permissions and sends Planner data only to Microsoft 365 services.
